g.text: Deterministic triage pipeline: path resolution, ownership validation, flock cleanup, and socket probe

text.tspan: Verify parent directory permissions before checking
the socket inode itself to isolate access errors.

g.text: If lock held & PID alive: attach to session
If PID dead: automatically clean stale socket

text.tspan: Flock guarantees single-daemon invariant per user.
Verify daemon PID liveness before removing locks.
GUI reconnects with backoff up to 2.5s

g.text: FERRYX CORE ARCHITECTURE · DAEMON IPC SUBSYSTEM
